up: Retrieve all IC50 activity data (standard_value in nM, standard_relation '=') for the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL6020 (human bile salt export pump). For each result, return: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id from docs, fallback to doi if pubmed_id is null), standard_value, standard_units, assay_description (from assays), and target information (pref_name, chembl_id from target_dictionary). Join activities -> assays -> target_dictionary to filter by tid corresponding to CHEMBL6020. Join activities -> compound_records -> molecule_dictionary for compound info. Left join compound_structures for SMILES. Left join docs for pubmed_id/doi. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL6020' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
